selection: Uniform sample of1024 eligible held-out boards without replacement, fixed RNG seed121437. Within each board choose highest difference in best-A2-pip loss; then highest common total pips, then smallest high/low vertex IDs. Selection never uses network logits, values or outcomes.
policy: Both seats frozen Generation37, greedy legal decisions, no search/no noise/no resignation. Complete B2 road and A2 settlement/road greedily, then play to terminal or500turn cap. Within each pair use same initial seed/RNG state; later stochastic events can desynchronize streams.
uncertainty: One continuation per condition per independent board. Paired board mean difference and normal95%CI; conditional on matched selection and this frozen policy. Selection fixed before outcome evaluation.
interpretation: A comparison of forced complete-game counterfactuals matched on own production, starting resource cards and direct-port type. Differences in geometry, number identities/correlations, distant ports, road opportunities and chosen followup actions remain, so the win-rate difference cannot be attributed solely to denial.
